trends.name: Public-DeFi Run Risk for Institutional Rails
trends.description: The trust assumption that institutional rails inherit safety simply by sitting above public DeFi protocols was tested at scale by the KelpDAO LayerZero bridge exploit. A fraudulent bridge message minted ~116,500 unbacked rsETH tokens, Aave's oracle read them as valid collateral, and depositors withdrew $15.1bn in 3.5 days. BlackRock BUIDL, SocGen MiCA stablecoins, Franklin Templeton, Coinbase USDC and Kraken DeFi Earn all route through the same bridge-and-oracle layer.

vim.v_anchor: KelpDAO single exploit removed $15.1bn from Aave in 3.5 days
vim.i_anchor: Affects institutional fixed-income, stablecoin issuance, custody, structured-credit
vim.m_anchor: TRL 5; structural risk surfacing through public-DeFi governance gaps

[Issue #68 (2026-05-27)] CHALLENGED: Spain's reclassification of prediction-market venues as gambling and the five-country alignment (Spain, Portugal, Brazil, Indonesia, India) pushes the regulatory perimeter toward jurisdictional ISP-level enforcement rather than purely protocol-design risk, easing the institutional-rails reading at the consumer-jurisdiction end without resolving it. [Issue #71 (2026-06-01)] CHALLENGED: The window's digital-asset prints (a bank-issued stablecoin, a MiCA-narrowed authorised-issuer field, the ICBA charter petition) push toward more contained, regulated rails rather than ungoverned protocols, continuing the easing of the near-term run-risk reading without resolving the underlying bridge-and-oracle question. trends.strategic_implications: Counterparty-evaluation and operational-resilience frameworks for stablecoin and tokenised-asset infrastructure now need to model bridge-and-oracle assumptions explicitly. cla.worldview: Two competing reads: (a) institutional rails harden the layer below DeFi and continue routing; (b) institutional rails withdraw from public DeFi and operate parallel permissioned infrastructure.
cla.myth: The Tower of Babel: a shared trust infrastructure that translates between chains, but the translation can be forged.

trends.leading_indicators: A major incumbent publicly restates an AI business case on higher running costs; a frontier vendor abandons per-token pricing at scale; token spend appears as a named line in a FTSE 100 cost programme
